name: Goose notes
notes:
HONK.
This is my desktop now.

I brought you a window.
You are welcome.

Your mouse has been selected
for a brief goose inspection.

Meeting agenda:
1. Honk
2. Snacks
3. More honk

I found this important document.
It says HONK.

I have checked your work.
Needs more goose.

You look busy.
I can fix that.

The footprints are temporary.
My commitment to nonsense is not.

Wish you were here.
The desktop is lovely at this hour.
Honk.

Greetings from the taskbar.
Having a wonderful time.
Wish you were pond-side.

INVOICE #001: snacks consumed during your meeting.
Payment due in peas.
Honk.

Snack audit complete.
You owe the goose one (1) crumb.
Payable immediately.

POND REPORT: water still wet.
Ripples nominal.
Duck cooperative.

POND REPORT: splashed twice.
Regrets: none.
Honk.
THIS COULD HAVE BEEN A HONK
